title: MODAL CARDS LOSE THE CHAMFER TICK
why: Critic 49 on the pause card: a one-off chamfered corner and a 48 wide tab, the style guide says no corner tick and a 36 x 2 tab. Every modal card and the pause card become a plain 4px rectangle, the arcade cards share the tab width, End run sits 48 below Feedback.
now: Cards are a plain rectangle with a short accent tab and no cut corner.

edits.anchor: #root #pausebox::after{ content:'Esc  Resume'; font:600 var(--fs-label)/1 var(--f-cond); letter-spacing:var(--track); color:var(--tx-2); margin-top:var(--sp-1); }
